guide.title: Make defaultMD the default app for .md files
guide.step1.done: Already installed and running as an app.
guide.step1.manual: Click the 'App available' icon at the right of Edge's address bar, or choose ⋯ menu → Apps → 'Install this site as an app'.
guide.step2.desc: In Windows Settings → Apps → Default apps, type .md in the search box at the top and choose defaultMD. (Same for .markdown)
guide.step3.desc: The first time you double-click a .md file, Edge asks for permission to open it. Choose 'Allow' (always allow).
guide.note: New versions are applied automatically when you open the app.
